theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_sl_eilenberg
theorems.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ C : NNReal, ∀ (P : ℕ) (A : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), LipschitzOnWith L f A → ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ ∧ (∀ t, μHE[n] (A ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) ≤ φ t) ∧ ∫⁻ t, φ t ≤ (C : ℝ≥0∞) * (L : ℝ≥0∞) * μHE[n + 1] A
